cohort: 75 patients who underwent obstetrical hysterectomy at the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology KMC, Khairpur Mir's from August 2014 - July 2017.
finding: The incidence of obstetrical hysterectomy was 0.43% (1 in 228 deliveries), with morbidly adherent placenta being the most common indication (33.3%), followed by ruptured uterus (30.6%).
